detail.longDescription:
Start as an unknown agent with nothing but ambition and a cheap office chair. Scout promising young players, sign them to your agency, and guide them from hidden gems to household names. With every successful deal, your reputation grows and so does your empire.

RISE THROUGH GLOBAL LEAGUES
Navigate the competitive world of international basketball. From Brazil and Argentina to China and Europe, prove your skills on a worldwide stage. Climb the ladder until your clients are battling for spots in the D-League and eventually the pros.

MASTER THE DRAFT
Help your players make the leap from prospects to pros. Can you get them noticed by GMs, and push them up draft boards? Land a top-ten pick or chase the dream of discovering the next number one.

NEGOTIATE HUGE DEALS
Sit across the table from tough general managers and fight for every dollar. Secure massive contracts, bonuses, and incentives that keep your clients happy and your agency thriving. In this business, your negotiation skills are your greatest weapon.

SECURE ENDORSEMENTS
Turn your players into brands. Land sneaker sponsorships, energy drink ads, and national campaigns and collect your cut. The more fame they gain, the more cash flows into your pocket.

UPGRADE YOUR TEAM
Improve your office and expand your staff to take on more clients. Hire a top-tier Scout to uncover future superstars, a razor-sharp Commercial Manager to pull in sponsors, and a training-minded Coach to elevate your players’ skills.

LIVE LARGE OR INVEST
Success comes with perks. Spend your earnings on luxury properties, or invest in sports teams to prove you’re the real deal. Your lifestyle becomes part of your legend.

BECOME A POWER PLAYER
As your reputation skyrockets, teams start calling you. Will you stay loyal to your early clients, or chase the richest offers? In the high-stakes world of basketball management, every choice shapes your legacy.
